summary: Fix confirmed. Building the extension with the repository's setup.py at 8d3477648f0a (fix parent and only affected commit) failed: ninja reported 'multiple rules generate .../stloader.o', because stloader.cpp and stloader.cu share a stem in the same directory (build-8d3477648f0a.log). At the fix 3c801c61b014, which renames the CUDA file to stloader_cu.cu, the same build succeeded and produced exllamav3_ext.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so (build-3c801c61b014.log). The same collision blocked in-memory-weight-transpose 001 at 647bb7d549b8.
what_ran: repro.py runs `python setup.py build_ext --build-lib <tmp> --build-temp <tmp>` in the worktree with torch's cpp_extension (ninja), Python 3.11.15, torch 2.6.0+cu126, nvcc 12.8, TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=8.6, and saves the full build log.
limits: Ninja builds on Linux only; the non-ninja setuptools path and Windows/MSVC were not tried. One CUDA architecture (sm_86).
